items.title: 14.3.5 Analytical Expressions of u x v (Determinant formula for u x v) (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Ab tak humne \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v}\) ki lambai aur direction alag alag dekhi. Lekin agar vectors components mein diye hon, jaise \(2\underline{i} - \underline{j} + \underline{k}\), to angle aur right hand rule se kaam lamba ho jata hai. Is sabaq mein hum ek seedha formula banayenge jo components se foran cross product de de. Yeh is poore unit ka sab se zyada istemal hone wala formula hai.
Maan lijiye \(\underline{u} = a_1\underline{i} + b_1\underline{j} + c_1\underline{k}\) aur \(\underline{v} = a_2\underline{i} + b_2\underline{j} + c_2\underline{k}\). To

Distributive property (14.3.4 (iii)) se har term ko har term se zarb dete hain; \(3 \times 3 = 9\) hisse bante hain:
\[= a_1a_2(\underline{i} \times \underline{i}) + a_1b_2(\underline{i} \times \underline{j})\]
\[+ a_1c_2(\underline{i} \times \underline{k}) + b_1a_2(\underline{j} \times \underline{i})\]
\[+ b_1b_2(\underline{j} \times \underline{j}) + b_1c_2(\underline{j} \times \underline{k})\]
\[+ c_1a_2(\underline{k} \times \underline{i}) + c_1b_2(\underline{k} \times \underline{j})\]
\[+ c_1c_2(\underline{k} \times \underline{k})\]

In ko rakhne se:
\[= a_1b_2\underline{k} - a_1c_2\underline{j} - b_1a_2\underline{k}\]
\[\quad + b_1c_2\underline{i} + c_1a_2\underline{j} - c_1b_2\underline{i}\]

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Nau (9) terms chhe (6) kaise bane? Teen terms jin mein \(\underline{i} \times \underline{i}\), \(\underline{j} \times \underline{j}\), \(\underline{k} \times \underline{k}\) tha, woh zero vector ban kar khatam ho gaye. Baqi har product ko cyclic pattern se badla; jahan tarteeb chakkar ke ulat thi (jaise \(\underline{i} \times \underline{k}\)), wahan minus aaya: \(\underline{i} \times \underline{k} = -\underline{j}\).
Phir milte julte terms ikatthe kiye: \(\underline{i}\) wale \(b_1c_2\underline{i} - c_1b_2\underline{i}\); \(\underline{j}\) wale \(-a_1c_2\underline{j} + c_1a_2\underline{j} = -(a_1c_2 - c_1a_2)\underline{j}\); aur \(\underline{k}\) wale \(a_1b_2\underline{k} - b_1a_2\underline{k}\).
Kyun yeh zaroori hai: yeh formula ratta lagane ke liye lamba hai. Isi liye agla qadam ise ek determinant ki shakal mein yaad rakhne ka tareeqa hai.

Ab yeh \(3 \times 3\) determinant dekhiye:
\[\begin{vmatrix} \underline{i} & \underline{j} & \underline{k} \\ a_1 & b_1 & c_1 \\ a_2 & b_2 & c_2 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= (b_1c_2 - c_1b_2)\underline{i}\]
\[\quad - (a_1c_2 - c_1a_2)\underline{j}\]
\[\quad + (a_1b_2 - b_1a_2)\underline{k}\]

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein is determinant ki teesri row ka aakhri number \(c_3\) chhapa hai. Sahi \(c_2\) hai, kyun ke teesri row \(\underline{v}\) ke components \((a_2, b_2, c_2)\) hain. Agle equation (ii) mein kitab ne khud sahi \(c_2\) likha hai.
Equation (i) ke R.H.S ke terms bilkul wahi hain jo is determinant ko kholne se milte hain. Is liye

blocks.latex: \underline{u} \times \underline{v} = \begin{vmatrix} \underline{i} & \underline{j} & \underline{k} \\ a_1 & b_1 & c_1 \\ a_2 & b_2 & c_2 \end{vmatrix} \quad \text{(ii)}
blocks.text_alt: u cross v equals the determinant with first row i, j, k, second row a1, b1, c1 and third row a2, b2, c2, equation (ii)

blocks.text: Ise \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v}\) ka determinant formula kehte hain.

blocks.title: Note
blocks.text: Kitab ka note: equation (ii) ka R.H.S asal mein determinant nahin hai, kyun ke is ki saari entries scalars nahin (pehli row mein vectors \(\underline{i}, \underline{j}, \underline{k}\) hain). Yeh sirf equation (i) ke lambe expression ko yaad rakhne ka ek tareeqa hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Determinant formula chalane ka tareeqa, har dafa isi tarteeb se:
1. Row 1: \(\underline{i}, \underline{j}, \underline{k}\). Row 2: PEHLE vector ke components. Row 3: DOOSRE vector ke components.
2. \(\underline{i}\) wala hissa: \(\underline{i}\) ka column chhupaiye, bache hue \(2 \times 2\) ka cross-multiplication kijiye.
3. \(\underline{j}\) wala hissa: \(\underline{j}\) ka column chhupaiye, cross-multiply kijiye, aur aage MINUS lagaiye.
4. \(\underline{k}\) wala hissa: \(\underline{k}\) ka column chhupaiye aur cross-multiply kijiye.
Kyun rows ki tarteeb ahem hai: determinant ki do rows badal dein to us ka sign badal jata hai. Yeh bilkul \(\underline{v} \times \underline{u} = -\underline{u} \times \underline{v}\) wali baat hai.
Ab kitab ki misaal mein yeh formula chala kar dekhte hain.

blocks.title: Example 15
blocks.problem: Find a vector perpendicular to each of the vectors \(\underline{a} = 2\underline{i} - \underline{j} + \underline{k}\) and \(\underline{b} = 4\underline{i} + 2\underline{j} - \underline{k}\).
steps:
Given: \(\underline{a} = 2\underline{i} - \underline{j} + \underline{k}\) aur \(\underline{b} = 4\underline{i} + 2\underline{j} - \underline{k}\).
To find: aisa vector jo \(\underline{a}\) aur \(\underline{b}\) dono par perpendicular ho.
Method: sab se pehle sochte hain ke aisa vector kahan se milega. Definition kehti hai ke \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b}\) hamesha \(\underline{a}\) aur \(\underline{b}\) dono par perpendicular hota hai. Bas yahi chahiye! To determinant formula (ii) se \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b}\) nikalenge, aur phir dot product se tasdeeq karenge.

Step 1: Determinant likhiye
\[\underline{a} \times \underline{b} = \begin{vmatrix} \underline{i} & \underline{j} & \underline{k} \\ 2 & -1 & 1 \\ 4 & 2 & -1 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: pehli row mein \(\underline{i}, \underline{j}, \underline{k}\); doosri row mein pehle vector \(\underline{a}\) ke components \((2, -1, 1)\); teesri row mein doosre vector \(\underline{b}\) ke components \((4, 2, -1)\). Rows ki tarteeb ahem hai: ulti karein to jawab ka sign ulat jayega.

Step 2: \(\underline{i}\) wala hissa (\(\underline{i}\) wala column chhupa dijiye)
\[(-1)(-1) - (1)(2) = 1 - 2 = -1\]
Kyun: pehla column chhupane ke baad jo \(2 \times 2\) hissa bacha, us ka cross-multiplication: seedhi diagonal ka product minus ulti diagonal ka product. Dhyan dein: \((-1)(-1) = +1\), minus ko minus se zarb dein to plus.

Step 3: \(\underline{j}\) wala hissa (\(\underline{j}\) column chhupaiye; aage minus)
\[-\big[(2)(-1) - (1)(4)\big]\]
\[= -(-2 - 4) = 6\]
Kyun: determinant kholte waqt beech wale term par hamesha minus lagta hai. Yahi woh jagah hai jahan sab se zyada ghaltiyan hoti hain, is liye bracket pehle poora hal kijiye, phir minus lagaiye.

Step 4: \(\underline{k}\) wala hissa (\(\underline{k}\) column chhupaiye)
\[(2)(2) - (-1)(4) = 4 + 4 = 8\]
Kyun: aakhri hissa pehle do columns se banta hai. \(-(-1)(4) = +4\), is liye \(4 + 4 = 8\).

Step 5: Teeno hisse jama kijiye
\[\underline{a} \times \underline{b} = -\underline{i} + 6\underline{j} + 8\underline{k}\]
Kyun: har hissa apne unit vector ke saath likha jata hai. Yahi kitab ka jawab hai.

Verification (kitab ki tarah): \(\underline{a}\) ke saath dot product
\[\underline{a} \cdot (\underline{a} \times \underline{b})\]
\[= (2\underline{i} - \underline{j} + \underline{k}) \cdot (-\underline{i} + 6\underline{j} + 8\underline{k})\]
\[= (2)(-1) + (-1)(6) + (1)(8)\]
\[= -2 - 6 + 8 = 0\]
Kyun: 14.2 mein seekha tha ke do vectors ka dot product zero ho to woh perpendicular hote hain.

Tasdeeq: \(\underline{b}\) ke saath dot product
\[\underline{b} \cdot (\underline{a} \times \underline{b})\]
\[= (4\underline{i} + 2\underline{j} - \underline{k}) \cdot (-\underline{i} + 6\underline{j} + 8\underline{k})\]
\[= (4)(-1) + (2)(6) + (-1)(8)\]
\[= -4 + 12 - 8 = 0\]
Dono dot products zero aaye, is liye \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b}\) waqai \(\underline{a}\) aur \(\underline{b}\) dono par perpendicular hai. Agar koi ek zero na aata to samajh jaiye ke determinant mein kahin ghalti hai.
blocks.answer: \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b} = -\underline{i} + 6\underline{j} + 8\underline{k}\), jo \(\underline{a}\) aur \(\underline{b}\) dono par perpendicular hai. (Is ka koi bhi non-zero multiple, jaise \(\underline{i} - 6\underline{j} - 8\underline{k}\), bhi dono par perpendicular hai.)

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
(Hamari misaal, kitab ka sawal nahin.) \(\underline{u} = \underline{i} + 2\underline{j}\) aur \(\underline{v} = \underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\) ka cross product nikaliye. Components: \(\underline{u} = (1, 2, 0)\), \(\underline{v} = (0, 1, 3)\); jo component na likha ho woh zero hai.
\(\underline{i}\): \(2 \cdot 3 - 0 \cdot 1 = 6\). \(\underline{j}\): \(-(1 \cdot 3 - 0 \cdot 0) = -3\). \(\underline{k}\): \(1 \cdot 1 - 2 \cdot 0 = 1\).
Jawab: \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v} = 6\underline{i} - 3\underline{j} + \underline{k}\). Tasdeeq: \((1)(6) + (2)(-3) + (0)(1) = 0\) aur \((0)(6) + (1)(-3) + (3)(1) = 0\). Dono zero, jawab sahi.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Example 15 mein agar \(\underline{b} \times \underline{a}\) poocha jata to jawab kya hota? (Jawab: \(\underline{i} - 6\underline{j} - 8\underline{k}\), yani \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b}\) ka ulta, kyun ke rows badalne se sign badal jata hai.)

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v} = \begin{vmatrix} \underline{i} & \underline{j} & \underline{k} \\ a_1 & b_1 & c_1 \\ a_2 & b_2 & c_2 \end{vmatrix}\); pehla vector row 2 mein.
2. Khula hua: \((b_1c_2 - c_1b_2)\underline{i} - (a_1c_2 - c_1a_2)\underline{j} + (a_1b_2 - b_1a_2)\underline{k}\).
3. Jawab dono vectors par perpendicular hota hai: do dot products zero aa kar tasdeeq karte hain.
4. Yeh asal determinant nahin, sirf yaad rakhne ka tareeqa hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(\underline{j}\) wale hisse ke aage minus bhool jana. Bachne ka tareeqa: \(\underline{j}\) likhte hi pehle minus aur bracket likh lijiye, phir andar hisaab kijiye.
2. Doosre vector ko row 2 mein rakh dena: poore jawab ka sign ulat jata hai.
3. Negative numbers ke sath sign ki ghalti, jaise \((-1)(-1) = +1\) ko \(-1\) likh dena.
4. Jo component diya na ho (jaise \(\underline{u} = \underline{i} + 2\underline{j}\) mein \(\underline{k}\)) us ki jagah 0 likhna bhool jana.
